### 🧭 In a nutshell

I design and implement numerical models to simulate complex physical systems:
from rigorous finite element schemes to hybrid approaches coupling physical
models with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs).

My methods are transferable across domains. My applications have included:

- acoustic propagation in subsonic flow (aeronautics)
- plant root dynamics
- biomass dynamics in African savannas
- modelling of cocoa-based agroforests (Cameroon)


### 🛠️ Technical stack

| Area | Tools |
|---|---|
| Languages | Fortran 90, Python, Julia |
| ML librairies | TensorFlow, PyTorch |
| Numerical methods | FEM (continuous, Discontinuous Galerkin), PINN |
| Solvers | MUMPS, Levenberg-Marquardt |
| Visualisation | ParaView (VTK), Matplotlib |
| Workflow | Git, Make, LaTeX, Dataverse, Software Heritage |
